query:
SELECT createat            AS "create_at!",
                   updateat            AS "update_at!",
                   deleteat            AS "delete_at!",
                   message             AS "message!",
                   rootid              AS "root_id!",
                   channelid           AS "channel_id!",
                   userid              AS "user_id!",
                   fileids             AS "file_ids?",
                   props               AS "props?",
                   priority            AS "priority?",
                   COALESCE(type, '')  AS "draft_type!"
              FROM drafts
             WHERE userid = $1 AND channelid = $2 AND rootid = $3
               AND ($4 OR deleteat = 0)
